Review without mutation

Adopt one coherent baseline

Keep recovery honest
Unknown source identity is unverified, not proof of a changed list. Missing fields remain unavailable. An absent company cannot be adopted. Close restores focus to Review; Back/Forward restores matching origin and selection.
Landmark

Targets & focus
Origin controls: 36px desktop / 40px mobile. Review actions and close: at least 44px. Use a 2px focus outline with 2px offset. Tab order follows visible actions; close and Escape restore focus to Review. Disabled Previous/Next are skipped.
Copy law
State word first, receipt second. No hashes, keys or slugs on screen. Direction, health and provisional status keep their own ink; nothing else is coloured.
